name: Holding Bossrim
description: Settles the shield's weight along the forearm with the elbow bent so the board covers chin to knee.

name: Solid Shieldarm
description: Plants the board square before the chest and braces the shoulder behind it to take a straight blow.

name: Hooding Rim
description: Tilts the board a hand's breadth outward so a cut slides along the face and off the edge.

name: Angled Boss
description: Sets the shoulder hard behind the board and locks the knees to stop an opponent's shoving charge.

name: Rimamble
description: Advances in short heel-to-toe steps while keeping the board between the body and the opponent.

name: Cover Strike
description: Jabs the lower rim of the shield into the opponent's shin or instep from behind the board.

name: Bashbump
description: Drives the central boss into the opponent's chest with a thread of qi sent through the shoulder.

name: Wardblow
description: Knocks the boss against the opponent's weapon wrist to loosen the grip before closing in.

name: Holding Enarme
description: Rolls the boss across an incoming thrust so the point skids off the curve of the metal.

name: Facedodge
description: Advances with the boss leading and the board slightly open to answer whatever the opponent offers.

name: Fouling Backbrace
description: Presses the boss down on the opponent's blade and holds it pinned against the ground or the opponent's thigh.

name: Bossstrike
description: Chops the upper rim down onto the opponent's collarbone in a short snapping motion from behind cover.

name: Folded Strap
description: Presents the flat of the board to meet a cut at its middle so the force spreads across the wood.

name: Backboard Husk
description: Turns the board toward the open side to sweep a swinging blow wide of the body.

name: Covercowl
description: Hooks the top rim over the opponent's raised weapon arm and pulls it off its line.

name: Facehit
description: Scrapes the rim down a polearm's shaft into the opponent's leading hand to break the hold.

name: Quiet Ward
description: Slips a quarter step sideways so the board still covers the body as the angle of attack changes.

name: Warm Edgeband
description: Holds the upper rim at eye level so the bearer watches the opponent's feet and shoulders over the edge.

name: Folded Face
description: Lifts the shield until the rim stands at brow height and holds it there with qi steadying the arm.

name: Cover Dodge
description: Lunges forward on the lead foot with the raised guard held tight against the opponent's overhead cuts.

name: Raised Backboard
description: Catches a downward cut on the angled upper board and lets the blade ride off past the shoulder.

name: Straight Shoulderset
description: Drops the raised rim edge-first onto the opponent's forearm as the cut lands on the board.

name: Bashdodge
description: Pivots on the ball of the lead foot with the guard held high to face a flanking opponent.

name: Hooding Edgeband
description: Tilts the raised board forward so a thrown missile or arrow slides up and over the bearer.

name: Shovedash
description: Thrusts the rim up under the opponent's chin from the raised guard with a pulse of qi in the arm.

name: Soft Backbrace
description: Breathes slowly behind the raised guard and spreads qi through the arm to relieve its weight.

name: Raised Face
description: Adjusts the forearm strap so the shield hangs a fist from the elbow and rides without twisting.

name: Snug Shieldarm
description: Clenches the handgrip with the last three fingers while the thumb and forefinger stay loose to turn the board.

name: Enarme Cowl
description: Takes a heavy blow with the arm locked into the strap so the shock runs into the shoulder.

name: Raised Rim
description: Flicks the wrist at the handgrip to swing the board edge across and away from a quick cut.

name: Single Ward
description: Swings the shield out on its strap in a short arc so the rim strikes the opponent's hip.

name: Towing Bash
description: Snaps the shield back along the strap after a strike so the board returns over the body.

name: Easing Boss
description: Shuffles sideways in small steps with the board always turned toward the opponent's weapon side.

name: Bossskitter
description: Retreats on the back foot while the shield stays forward and level to cover the withdrawal.

name: Shovetrot
description: Pivots on the lead foot to bring the board around against a flanking cut without losing cover.

name: Solid Edgeband
description: Crosses the rear foot over the front and plants the board against a charge from the side.

name: Buffetamble
description: Closes a gap of two paces behind the board so the opponent has no room to swing.

name: Bossrim Lid
description: Drags the heel sideways and angles the board to let a charging opponent slide past.

name: Bossstay
description: Circles the opponent while holding the board as a moving screen so the next strike is hard to read.

name: Resting Backbrace
description: Drops into a low wide stance behind the board and takes a running charge without being driven back.

name: Resting Strap
description: Sinks the hips and sets both feet flat so the board rests against the ground-braced legs.

name: Kept Shieldarm
description: Digs the rear foot into the ground and leans the whole body weight into the board.

name: Buffetbump
description: Rises from the planted stance and heaves the board forward and up into the opponent's torso.

name: Nimble Bossrim
description: Breaks from the stance with one sliding step so the opponent's charge passes the board's edge.

name: Raised Boss
description: Receives a cut on the upper board and turns it away with a thread of qi along the arm.

name: Solid Enarme
description: Catches a chest-high thrust on the middle of the board and lets the point bite harmlessly into the wood.

name: Hooding Strap
description: Drops the lower board to sweep a low cut aside before it reaches the knee.

name: Holding Face
description: Rolls the shield's edge toward a blow that lands off-center and carries its force outward.

name: Holding Backboard
description: Angles a corner of the board to meet a hooking blade before it can turn behind the rim.

name: Strap Wedge
description: Fills the shield arm with qi at the moment of impact so a heavy swing stops against the board.

name: Rimstrike
description: Taps the rim against the opponent's hand the instant a turned cut leaves it exposed.

name: Tending Rim
description: Reads the weight and angle of the last blow from how the board hums in the forearm.

name: Solid Rim
description: Drops into a crouch with the board tilted forward so head and chest vanish behind its face.

name: Folded Backbrace
description: Kneels with the board slanted over the body so thrown darts and stones strike its face.

name: Raised Enarme
description: Slides the lower rim to the ground so low cuts at the shins strike the board instead.

name: Shifting Shove
description: Moves forward in a half-crouch with the board dragged ahead to cover advancing feet.

name: Shovedrop
description: Springs up from behind the board and drives the upper rim into the opponent's jaw.

name: Catching Shove
description: Hooks the lower rim behind the opponent's ankle and pulls to unbalance a charging stride.

name: Warm Shieldarm
description: Raises the eyes over the upper rim in one quick glance and drops back behind the board.

name: Enarmedash
description: Drives the whole face of the board into the opponent's torso with a pulse of qi behind the legs.

name: Facepause
description: Slides the lower rim under the opponent's lead leg and heaves upward to break the stance.

name: Bossdrop
description: Walks the opponent backward with steady pushes of the board and qi driven through each step.

name: Buffettrot
description: Wedges the board edge between the opponent's guard and body to force a way inside.

name: Kept Boss
description: Plants the feet and sets the board square after a push so the return shove is stopped.

name: Enarmelid
description: Pins a fallen opponent's arm or leg to the ground by dropping the rim across it and leaning.

name: Holding Edgeband
description: Lifts a heavy shield from hip to brow and lowers it slowly to build the shoulder.

name: Kept Face
description: Rolls the shoulder to swing the heavy board across the body and back to the guard.

name: Hooding Face
description: Holds the loaded shield at arm's length for a slow count until the forearm stops shaking.

name: Solid Backboard
description: Turns the whole body with the heavy board to sweep a swinging blow wide.

name: Gnawing Bash
description: Heaves the heavy board forward from the hip so its weight lands against the opponent's chest.

name: Buffethop
description: Drags the heavy board along the ground while stepping forward to build leg and back strength.

name: Settled Bossrim
description: Changes the heavy board from a low guard to a high guard in one fluid lift.

name: Backbrace Gauge
description: Locks the elbow against the ribs to rest the arm while the board stays up.

name: Flat Shove
description: Swings the cudgel over the shield's upper rim at the opponent's head with qi in the striking arm.

name: Ready Bossrim
description: Pulls the cudgel back along the shield's edge to guard the hand while the board takes the blow.

name: Gnawing Cover
description: Strikes with the rim and follows at once with a cudgel blow while the opponent is staggered.

name: Bosscowl
description: Hooks the cudgel's end behind the opponent's guard arm to pull it open for the rim.

name: Facehusk
description: Traps an opponent's blade between the cudgel and the shield's edge and holds it fast.

name: Light Shoulderset
description: Shifts weight from the shield foot to the cudgel foot as the strike lands and the board covers.

name: Kind Strap
description: Taps the cudgel tip against the opponent's weapon to feel its weight and grip before committing.
